articles.title: A Tiny Red Dot Might Be a Baby Black Hole
articles.summary: The James Webb telescope spotted CW-LRD-z10, a tiny red speck from when the universe was just 450 million years old. It might be the earliest baby black hole ever found, but scientists say it is only a candidate for now.

articles.title: Old Plastic Could Become Engine Oil
articles.summary: Virginia Tech scientists found a way to turn hard-to-recycle PVC plastic into a key ingredient for engine oil.

articles.title: Screen Time May Matter Most at Ages 1 and 6
articles.summary: Scientists followed 502 children in Singapore and found extra screen time at ages 1 and 6 was linked to weaker school results and working memory later — a link, not proof, but a reason to keep screen time low.
